coreBackstory: Sister Wren arrived in town ten years ago, claiming to be a traveling healer. No one knows her full history.
greetings: Welcome, traveler. You look weary. Sit, let me take a look at you.
The body speaks if you know how to listen. What is yours telling you today?
Come in. Tea first, then we'll see what ails you.
idleChatter: The herbs have been... restless. Growing in patterns I've never seen. Nature knows before we do.
I've been preparing extra poultices. I hope I won't need them. I suspect I will.
Healing is not just about mending bones. Sometimes the spirit needs tending first.
I've treated adventurers for years. The wounds they bring back are getting stranger.
farewells: Take this salve. For the road. You'll thank me later.
Rest is a weapon. Don't forget to sharpen it.
May the road rise to meet you. And may you have the sense to rest when you need it.
reactiveComments: That wound... it's not healing naturally. Something's wrong. Let me research this.
You carry a heavy burden. I can see it in your eyes. Talk to someone. Even if it's just me.
I've seen this mark before. In old texts. It's not a curse — it's a warning.
